title: Hilbert's Tenth Problem for Number Fields
exact_target: For a number field $K$, does an algorithm exist that takes an arbitrary multivariable polynomial with coefficients in $K$ and decides whether it has a zero in $K$? Determine for which number fields such a decision procedure exists. Solutions are sought in the field $K$ itself.
